KB.Article.Stations.Title: KINK, KINK Distortion, 80's & 90's
KB.Article.Stations.Summary: Direct live streams for all four KINK channels with live track metadata.
KB.Article.Stations.Body:
Includes the four official KINK live channels: KINK (main), KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's at 192 kbps MP3 with automatic AAC fallback.

Current track information is parsed from ICY stream headers and synchronized with Windows 11 System Media Transport Controls (SMTC).
KB.Article.Tray.Title: Background Playback & System Tray
KB.Article.Tray.Summary: Collapse cleanly to the system tray with low RAM footprint while audio keeps playing.
KB.Article.Tray.Body:
When closing or minimizing the window, KINK Radio hides into the Windows 11 notification area and purges its XAML view tree via GC.Collect(1).

Right-click the tray icon at any time to switch stations, pause or resume playback, toggle mute, or restore the window.
KB.Article.Storage.Title: Isolated Storage & Single-Instance
KB.Article.Storage.Summary: Settings stored under %AppData%\KinkRadio with single-instance activation redirect.
KB.Article.Storage.Body: Station selection, volume, and preferences persist atomically in %AppData%\KinkRadio\. Launching KINK Radio a second time brings the active instance back into focus.
Changelog.v010.AddedRadio: Added all four KINK live radio stations: KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's (192 kbps MP3 with AAC fallback).
Changelog.v010.AddedTray: Added system tray lifecycle (close/minimize to task tray) with right-click controls for station switching, play/pause, and mute.
Changelog.v010.AddedIcySmtc: Added live ICY Now Playing track metadata and Windows 11 SMTC media key integration on the Chassis Fluent 2 shell.
